newsitem.title: FRANCE: German July/Feb wheat sales to non-EU down 36 pct.
newsitem.headline: German July/Feb wheat sales to non-EU down 36 pct.

text.p: Germany sold 1.05 million tonnes of soft wheat grain to non-EU countries between July 1, 1996, and March 1, 1997, or 36 percent less than in the same period a year earlier REUTER MCW GDJ, statistics from national grain office ONIC showed.
The sales included 360,000 tonnes of wheat shipped to Poland and 228,000 tonnes shipped to Uzbekistan.

Germany also sold during the first eight months of the 1996/97 (July/June) season 1.33 milion tonnes of wheat to its partners in the European Union compared with 1.81 million tonnes during the same period a year earlier.
